### 🧹 Your house is tidy. What about the housekeeper?

HA Housekeeper is a hobby project and stays free. You can help in three ways:

- ⭐ **Star it on GitHub**: it makes the project easier to find
- 🐞 **Report a finding**: bugs and ideas as an [issue](https://github.com/bertel2020/HA-Housekeeper/issues/new/choose)
- ☕ **Tip the housekeeper:**
